phase: Refined proposed E2E before any shared implementation; do not require one particular media reuse/cleanup architecture
reason: Do not assume a finite lane reuses the same HTMLAudioElement after replacement or keeps a completed element/source attached. Observe actual ended events plus live voices. Add the declared350ms HTTP source delay so the replacement case is a real delayed source, not404. The DOM selector ignores detached/cleared/paused obsolete elements so implementations may release rather than reuse them.
